## Objective

Provide optional ontology-only vector fallback and measure its value.

## Scope

- Separate embedding index
- Exact-match priority
- Reproducible baseline comparison

## Entry conditions

- Explicit semantic profile/model provisioning is authorized when needed.

## Exit criteria

- A missed paraphrase resolves to a sourced semantic match while exact identities retain priority.
- A reproducible comparison reports correctness, attribution, resource use and failures.

## Risks

- Model caches and input corpora must remain distinct from memory.

## TASK-020 - Implement explicit ontology embedding builds

Build an ontology-only vector index over selected approved definitions/documentation with exact model artifact, source and index versions.

| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A model name alone is not an immutable model version.

### Acceptance criteria

- Only an explicit build writes the index; reads never download models or refresh it.
- Selected model revision/file hashes, corpus scope and stale-index status are visible; memory files and caches remain unchanged.

### Planned verification

- Build an index with the actual selected offline model after authorized provisioning.
- Change selected inputs and verify stale detection, model mismatch and excluded-source rejection.

## TASK-021 - Integrate sourced semantic fallback

Add bounded vector fallback after exact ID/label/alias/graph resolution and label every semantic result with its evidence and uncertainty.

| Dependencies | TASK-020 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- No live source expansion beyond selected/frozen inputs.

### Acceptance criteria

- An otherwise missed paraphrase returns the expected sourced concept, while exact matches retain priority.
- Similarity neither asserts equivalence nor approves a concept; disabled/unavailable profiles preserve core results.

### Planned verification

- Exercise exact-match competitors, paraphrases, stale-index, no-match and frozen-source cases.
- Verify semantic results retain source types in mixed knowledge queries.

Compare first-release lexical/graph retrieval against the selected semantic/graph-assisted proposal workflow on fixed competency cases.

### Risks

- Do not tune away hard cases solely to advertise improvement.

### Acceptance criteria

- The report binds dataset, ontology/config/model versions, expected facts/sources, correctness, attribution, resource use and failures.
- Neutral/negative outcomes are retained and extracted graphs remain exploratory/proposed.

### Planned verification

- Run the identical labeled case set against both modes with recorded commands and versions.
- Inspect unsupported claims, false equivalences and proposal regressions rather than adopting external percentages.
